breaking.change: New projects no longer export an empty og.game({}). They wire built-in title, main menu, pause, settings and save/load screens through a session state machine and named presentation stores. Platform/input choices configure device defaults; lang writes imported shell tables and fonts; the look still selects the UI pack. The shell is only built-in screens and controls, in the dark scheme. Interactive films use the same shell over the engine FlowScreen.
breaking.fix: Keep the generated src/shell.tsx and shell-state.ts. Customize strings, give the title and main menu key art and a logo with setShellArt before startShell, initialize gameplay before startShell, and bind gameplay systems to state session / value playing. Complete locale entries seeded in English where the engine has no translation. Do not overwrite src/main.ts with an empty game. Existing og new --look --premise --no-prompt arguments, exit codes and manifest paths are unchanged.

fixed: Title, pause, settings and save/load screens take their initial focus, so keyboard/gamepad confirm and back work immediately when they open. Main menu and save/load content respect device safe areas. The empty slider track uses the opaque track token rather than a low-contrast translucent fill.
